description: Source code for Maintenance Schedule doctype in ERPNext, including class MaintenanceSchedule with methods for schedule generation, validation, and related operations.

classes.name: MaintenanceSchedule
classes.description: Class representing maintenance scheduling, including schedule generation, validation, and related operations.

methods.name: generate_schedule
methods.description: Generates maintenance schedules based on items and their details.

methods.name: validate_end_date_visits
methods.description: Validates and calculates end dates and number of visits based on periodicity.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions upon submission, including validation, event creation, and status update.

methods.name: create_schedule_list
methods.description: Creates a list of scheduled dates between start and end dates.

methods.name: validate_schedule_date_for_holiday_list
methods.description: Adjusts schedule date to avoid holidays based on employee or company holiday list.

methods.name: validate_dates_with_periodicity
methods.description: Ensures date ranges are compatible with selected periodicity.

methods.name: validate_maintenance_detail
methods.description: Validates maintenance item details such as item code, dates, and sales person.

methods.name: validate_sales_order
methods.description: Checks for existing maintenance schedules linked to sales orders.

methods.name: validate_no_of_visits
methods.description: Validates total number of visits against schedule items.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Runs all validation routines before saving or submitting.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Resets status to Draft on update.

methods.name: update_amc_date
methods.description: Updates AMC expiry date for serial numbers.

methods.name: validate_serial_no
methods.description: Validates serial numbers for warranty, AMC, and delivery date constraints.

methods.name: check_serial_no_added
methods.description: Checks if serial numbers are added for schedule items.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation, including updating AMC dates and deleting events.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Deletes related events when record is trashed.

methods.name: get_pending_data
methods.description: Retrieves pending schedule data based on type (date, items, id).
